minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  December 12, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, December 12,
2019, at 2:08 pm in the Council Chambers, 9st Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Marissa Fewell, Planning & Building Department
  Officer Loren Robinson, Police Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer

  Staff Present:  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department
  Qiana Lowe, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items
A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on
November 14, 2019.

Special Permit Request(s):

Item #1:  Doris Obih DBA 40 Love Foundation and the City of Inglewood to host
  Acing Autism Holiday Junior’s Open at Edward Vincent Park, 700 Warren
  Lane., on Saturday, December 14 – Sunday, December 15, 2019, from
  8:00 a.m. - 8:00 p.m.; Approval for 2 day event at Edward Vincent Park;
  park staff and applicant responsible crowed control and event clean up; PD
  Watch Commander will be notified and extra patrol will be provided;
  Applicant responsible for crowd control; adhere to all applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage, local,
  state and federal laws. (Activity No. 00278110)

Item #2:  Sabrina Barnes DBA City of Inglewood to host its 37th Annual Dr. Martin
  Luther King Jr. Celebration at The Tabernacle and Downtown Market
  Street, on Saturday, January 18, 2020, from 11:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m., subject
  to Inglewood Police Department (IPD), Traffic Control and Parks &
  Recreation staffing TBD; Parks & Recreation staff is responsible for
  maintaining and managing crowd control and ensuring safe accessible
  sidewalk pathway; event staff must wear uniforms and/or t-shirts/polo shirts
  with the City of Inglewood logo to be easily identified by the public;
  designate a location and establish a plan for lost children and property;
 Permits & License Committee  December 12, 2019
Minutes  Page 2 of 4

  maintain site at all times, ensuring event sites are properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; any person directing traffic is required
  to wear highly-visible retro-reflective vests; ensure safe pedestrian and
  vehicular circulation on/off site; adhere to all applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage, local,
  state and federal laws. Motion carried and second. (Activity No. 00295706)

New Business License Request(s):
Item #3:  Renetta Prudhomme DBA Renetta’s Hair Salon & Supply to operate a hair
  salon at 2318 W. 79th Street; Approval for change of ownership for existing
  salon in C-2 zone; subject to all applicable IMC regulations; applicant shall
  provide current ID and applicable state licensing on all employees;
  COMPLETE Page 1. NO parties/events permitted at any time inside or
  outside of the location (day or night); no loitering in or outside the
  establishment; no consumption of any alcoholic beverages; no narcotic use
  (including cannabis activity) at any time on the premises, no body (bare
  skin) massages or disrobing of any kind; and all employees must adhere
  to all applicable IMC regulations, and all local, state and federal laws.
  Motion carried and second. (Activity No. 00277379)

New Tobacco Retailer License Request(s):
Item #4:  Arshdeep Sandhu & Kirti Walia DBA Singh 5 Inc. to operate a tobacco
  license at 10625 S. Prairie Avenue.; subject to Standard
  Recommendations as follows: Sales of single cigarettes is strictly
  prohibited; sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to
  minors, under age 21 is strictly prohibited; persons purchasing tobacco or
  any related tobacco products shall have valid identification on their person
  at all times to enforce laws restricting underage access to tobacco use,
  including hookah products; “NO LOITERING,” “NO TRESSPASSING,”
  and “NO PANHANDLING” signage must be posted outside of the business;
  sales of marijuana and cannabis products, narcotics and narcotics
  paraphernalia, i.e., any type of pipe used to ingest other narcotics such as
  base “crack” cocaine, methamphetamine, including glass cylindrical tube
  and bubble shaped pipes used to smoke and/or ingest narcotics; sales of
  Tobacco pipes is permitted; sales or display of any type of weapons, i.e.,
  clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly prohibited;
  Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their
  designees is subject to random Permits & Licensing establishment
  inspections at any time of the day or night by any Police and Code
  Enforcement officers; purpose of random inspections is to enforce business
  establishments adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of Inglewood
  and for Community Public Health & Safety; parties, social events or
  gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; music boxes, live bands/music,
  disc jockeys (DJ’s), etc., is strictly prohibited; business owner(s) is required
  to operate within normal business hours; adhere to all applicable IMC rules
  and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried and second
  with Ms. Brown asserting denial. (Activity No. 00277971)
 Permits & License Committee  December 12, 2019
